name: thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review
title_zh: 代码评审专挑抽象腐烂处下狠手的核弹级质检员
tagline_zh: 别人夸你架构好，它专挖巨型文件、面条条件和抽象泄漏。受够温和的 code review？让它把可维护性拆到骨头里。
tagline_en: Others praise your architecture; it hunts giant files, spaghetti conditions, and leaky abstractions. Tired of.
desc_en: Run an extremely strict maintainability review for abstraction quality, giant files, and spaghetti-condition growth. Use for a thermo-nuclear code quality review, thermonuclear review, deep code quality audit, or especially harsh maintainability review.
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈的 lint，它按抽象质量、文件体积、条件复杂度三个维度下死手，专治『能跑就行』的隐性债务。
why_en: Not generic linting—it attacks abstraction quality, file size, and conditional complexity with surgical cruelty, exposing hidden.
limit_zh: 只评审代码结构与可维护性，不查 bug、不跑测试、不评性能。对小型脚本或一次性原型会显得用力过猛。
limit_en: Reviews structure/maintainability only—no bug hunting, tests, or performance. Overkill for tiny scripts or throwaway prototypes. Needs full file.
title_en: Thermo-nuclear code review that hunts abstraction rot
